# HelmCraft — Full Technical & LLM Reference

## Architecture Overview

HelmCraft is a local-first CEO & CFO executive dashboard and cross-fleet telemetry engine built in pure Rust. It enforces `#![deny(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]` across all crates:

- `helmcraft-store`: Live multi-database SQLite reader and executive snapshot store with point-in-time historical records.
- `helmcraft-core`: Executive board briefing synthesizer, cashflow forecaster, and risk analysis engine.
- `helmcraft-mcp`: Stdio JSON-RPC FastMCP server & CLI binary (`helmcraft`).
- `helmcraft-app`: Native desktop GUI executable (`helmcraft-app`) via `egui 0.37`.

## MCP Tools Reference

1. `helm_status`: Aggregates real-time executive dashboard KPIs across all craft business apps (Treasury, People, Ops Risk, Actions).
2. `helm_board_briefing`: Generates a comprehensive executive board briefing document with risks and strategic recommendations.
3. `helm_cashflow_forecast`: Projects cash runway and burn scenarios based on live receivables, subscriptions, and operating expenses.

## Telemetry Sources

Reads directly from local SQLite databases in read-only mode:
- `billcraft.db`: MRR, ARR, accounts receivable, overdue invoices.
- `spendcraft.db`: Travel and operational expenses.
- `teamcraft.db`: FTE headcount and Austrian AZG compliance.
- `hirecraft.db`: Open requisitions, active candidates, pending job offers.
- `gaincraft.db`: Customer health scores, churn risks, active retention CTAs.
- `taskcraft.db`: Active sprint issues, blocked tickets.
- `assetcraft.db`: IT hardware fleet and unassigned inventory.

## Configuration & Environment Variables

- `HELMCRAFT_DB`: Path to SQLite database file (default: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\helmcraft\helmcraft.db`).
- `CRAFT_BUS_DIR`: Root directory of atomic event bus (default: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\craft-biz-bus`).
